units.source_text: 通夜不断地诵经的僧人，到天明时分换了班，声音非常庄严。

en.t: The monks who had been chanting sutras without pause through the night changed shifts at dawn, and their voices sounded very solemn.

units.source_text: 阿阇梨也通夜诵念，偶尔打个瞌睡，此时也已醒来，开始朗诵陀罗尼经。

en.t: The acharya had also chanted all night, dozing now and then, but by this time he had awakened and began to recite the dharani scripture aloud.

units.source_text: 他虽然年老而喉音枯嗄，但因修行功夫甚深，听来法力甚宏。

en.t: Though he was old and his throat sounded hoarse, his deep religious discipline made his chanting seem filled with great spiritual power.

units.source_text: 他向薰中纳言探询：“今夜小姐病状如何？”

en.t: He asked Kaoru, the Middle Counselor, “How is the young lady’s illness tonight?”

units.source_text: 随即叙述八亲王旧事，屡次举袖拭泪。

en.t: He then spoke of old memories of the Eighth Prince, repeatedly lifting his sleeve to wipe away his tears.

units.source_text: 他说：“八亲王之灵不知现在何处。

en.t: He said, “I do not know where the spirit of the Eighth Prince may be now.

units.source_text: 据贫僧推想，定然早已往生西方极乐世界。

en.t: In my humble judgment, he must surely have long since been reborn in the Western Paradise.

units.source_text: 但前几天曾在梦中拜见，仍作世俗装束，对贫僧言道：‘我早已决心厌弃尘世，故对俗界毫无执着了。

en.t: But a few days ago I saw him in a dream, still dressed in worldly garments, and he said to this poor monk, ‘I resolved long ago to reject the dusty world, so I have no attachment to worldly life.

units.source_text: 只因对两女儿略有挂念，不免心乱，以致暂时不能往生净土，实甚遗憾。

en.t: Only because I remain a little anxious about my two daughters, my mind is disturbed, and for the moment I cannot be reborn in the Pure Land, which grieves me deeply.

units.source_text: 我想请你替我做些功德，助我往生。’

en.t: I would like to ask you to perform some meritorious rites for me and help me attain rebirth.’

units.source_text: 他这话说得非常清楚。

en.t: He spoke those words with great clarity.

units.source_text: 贫僧一时想不出应做何种功德，只得尽我所能，请五六位在我寺中修行的僧人称名念佛。

en.t: At first I could not think what kind of merit I should perform, so I did what I could and asked five or six monks practicing at my temple to recite the Buddha’s name.

units.source_text: 后又想得一法，叫他们举行‘常不轻’礼拜。”

en.t: Later I thought of another method and had them perform the Never-Disparaging bowing rite.”

units.source_text: 薰中纳言听了这话，深为感泣。

en.t: When Kaoru, the Middle Counselor, heard this, he was deeply moved to tears.

units.source_text: 大女公子闻知，心念我等两人竟妨碍了父亲往生极乐，罪孽实甚深重，悲伤之极，一时昏了过去。

en.t: When the elder lady heard of it, she thought that the two sisters had actually hindered their father’s rebirth in paradise, and overcome by grief at the depth of their sin, she fainted for a time.

units.source_text: 她躺在病榻上想道：“但愿于父亲尚未往生之前，我就去追随他，和他生在同一世界。”

en.t: Lying on her sickbed, she thought, “If only I could follow my father before he has yet been reborn, and be born with him in the same world.”

units.source_text: 阿阇梨并不长谈，不久就去做功德了。

en.t: The acharya did not speak at length, and before long he went off to perform the meritorious rites.

units.source_text: 举行“常不轻”礼拜的五六个僧人巡行附近各村庄，直到京都。

en.t: The five or six monks performing the Never-Disparaging bowing rite went around the nearby villages and as far as Kyoto.

units.source_text: 此时慑于晓风的寒威，回到了阿阇梨做功德的地方，来至山庄正门口，以非常尊严之声朗诵偈语，叩首礼拜。

en.t: Now, chilled by the harsh cold of the dawn wind, they returned to the place where the acharya was performing the rites, came to the front gate of the mountain villa, recited verses in very solemn voices, and bowed with their heads to the ground.

units.source_text: 唱到这回向经文的末句，大家深为感动。

en.t: When they reached the final line of this dedication of merit, everyone was deeply moved.

units.source_text: 薰中纳言原是深信佛法之人，其感动更是难于堪忍。

en.t: Kaoru, the Middle Counselor, had always believed deeply in the Buddhist law, and his emotion was all the harder for him to bear.

units.source_text: 二女公子频频挂念姐姐，走近后面的帷屏旁边来探看。

en.t: The younger lady, constantly worried about her elder sister, came near the curtain screen in the rear to look in on her.

units.source_text: 薰中纳言听到声息，立刻正襟危坐，对她言道：“二小姐听这‘常不轻’声音如何？

en.t: Hearing a sound, Kaoru, the Middle Counselor, immediately straightened his robes and sat formally, then said to her, “My younger lady, how does the sound of this Never-Disparaging rite seem to you?

units.source_text: 这虽然不是正大的法事，但也非常庄严。”

en.t: Although this is not a full formal Buddhist service, it is still very solemn.”

units.source_text: 便赋诗云：

en.t: He then composed a poem:
